# nsgame

> DAO-governed parimutuel prediction market on Solana. Subjects are adult-tube
> performance signals — porn-star view counts and cam-room viewer counts.
> Twenty-five hardcoded PvP fights, two boards (Stars: 4-hour windows, 15
> markets; Cams: 2-minute windows, 10 markets). Binary outcomes. Wallet is
> identity. No KYC. Settlement on-chain by the Goldilock oracle network.

Status: testnet. Mainnet gated on audits of oracle and contracts. Anything
claiming to be the nsgame token today is fraudulent.

- [Cookie Policy](https://nsgame.org/legal/cookie-policy): Essential, preferences, analytics. PostHog only.
- [Disclaimer](https://nsgame.org/legal/disclaimer): The protocol is not advice. The chain is not insurance.
- [Acceptable Use Policy](https://nsgame.org/legal/acceptable-use-policy): What gets your wallet refused at the door.
- [Risk Disclosure](https://nsgame.org/legal/risk-disclosure): Stakes can be lost. Pools can void. Smart contracts can fail.
- [DMCA Policy](https://nsgame.org/legal/dmca-policy): Copyright takedown procedure for the website.
- [Restricted Territories](https://nsgame.org/legal/restricted-territories): The standard decentralized-protocol blocklist.
- [Age Gate](https://nsgame.org/legal/age-gate): Adult subjects, adult product, adult affirmation required.

## Product

- [How It Works](https://nsgame.org/product/how-it-works): Connect wallet, pick a side, wait for the round to close.
- [Market Rules](https://nsgame.org/product/market-rules): The twenty-five fights, the two boards, the binary outcomes.
- [Round Mechanics](https://nsgame.org/product/round-mechanics): Open, lock, resolve. Stars run four hours. Cams run two minutes.
- [Parimutuel Methodology](https://nsgame.org/product/parimutuel-methodology): No house. The pool decides the price.
- [Settlement Rules](https://nsgame.org/product/settlement-rules): What the oracle reads, what it writes on-chain, when winners can claim.
- [Resolution Sources](https://nsgame.org/product/resolution-sources): xvideos, xnxx, pornhub, chaturbate. Public metrics only.
- [Fee Schedule](https://nsgame.org/product/fee-schedule): 0.3% of each winning payout, routed to the DAO treasury.
- [Refund Policy](https://nsgame.org/product/refund-policy): When a round voids and how stakes return.

## Trust

- [Decentralization and DAO](https://nsgame.org/trust/decentralization-and-dao): No incorporated entity. DAO in formation. The framing.
- [Goldilock Oracle Network](https://nsgame.org/trust/goldilock-oracle-network): The multi-oracle that signs settlements on-chain.
- [Data Source Methodology](https://nsgame.org/trust/data-source-methodology): What gets scraped, how often, how normalised.
- [Audit and Mainnet Roadmap](https://nsgame.org/trust/audit-and-mainnet-roadmap): What gates the move from testnet to mainnet.
- [Subject Removal Policy](https://nsgame.org/trust/subject-removal-policy): UI delisting yes, protocol delisting no. The honest line.
- [Token Status](https://nsgame.org/trust/token-status): A token is planned. Details will be published when finalised.
- [Market Integrity](https://nsgame.org/trust/market-integrity): Public data, public chain, public methodology.
